title: Turbary
summary: TUR'BARY, noun [from turf; Latinized, turbaria.] 1. In law, a right of digging turf on another man's land. Common of turbary is the liberty which a tenant enjoys of digging turf on the lord's waste. 2

inlines.v: TUR'BARY, noun [from turf; Latinized, turbaria.] 1. In law, a right of digging turf on another man's land. Common of turbary is the liberty which a tenant enjoys of digging turf on the lord's waste. 2. The place where turf is dug.
